question: Where is restaurant situated within 160 kilometers in the direction of Southern National Motorsport Park, Lucama, NC from Aquarium Outfitters Carolina, Wake Forest, NC?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-78.515805 35.970785)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-78.060871 35.61119)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-78.515805 35.970785)',4326)::geography, 160000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-78.515805 35.970785)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
